## 7. ESSENTIAL CLINICAL GUIDANCE FOR PATIENT PREPARATION

### Fasting Guidelines
- **Fasting Required (10–12 Hours)**: Lipid Profile, Iron Profile, Homocysteine. (Plain water permitted; no tea, coffee, milk, or breakfast).
- **Fasting Required (8–10 Hours)**: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS), Fasting Insulin, HOMA-IR, C-Peptide.
- **No Fasting Required**: Complete Blood Count (CBC), HbA1c, Thyroid Profile (T3/T4/TSH), Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Vitamin D3, Vitamin B12, All STI & HIV serology and PCR tests.

### STI Specimen Rules
- **First-Catch Urine (for Chlamydia/Gonorrhea/Trichomonas PCR)**: Must NOT urinate for 1–2 hours before sample collection. Collect the first 20–30 mL stream of urine (do not discard initial stream).
- **Pharyngeal Swabs (Oral Exposure)**: Avoid food, hot drinks, mouthwash, or brushing teeth for 1 hour before collection. Flocked Dacron swab collected from bilateral posterior pharyngeal wall and tonsillar pillars.
- **Venous Blood Serology (HIV/Syphilis/Hepatitis)**: Venous draw by trained phlebotomist; fingerstick rapid tests are NOT used at our reference laboratory due to superior analytical sensitivity of 4th Gen ECLIA.

## 11. QXL CLINICAL TEST GUIDE LIBRARY (60 ARTICLES, UPDATED 20 OCTOBER 2026)

Each guide explains what a test answers, who should consider it, sample/preparation, how to read results, limitations and FAQs. Unconfirmed operational details (price, tube, PIN-code eligibility) are stated as "check with QXL for more information"; the laboratory report's own reference intervals take precedence.

### 11A. 30-Part Medical Storytelling Series

#### Diabetes & Thyroid
- **HbA1c in Bengaluru: Understanding the Longer Sugar Story** — https://qxldiagnostics.com/blog/hba1c-bengaluru
  - Author/assigned reviewer: Dr. Shantakumar Muruda (medically reviewed)
  - Summary: HbA1c, or glycated haemoglobin, measures glucose attached to haemoglobin and helps assess longer-term blood-sugar exposure. QXL Diagnostics uses Roche cobas pro for HbA1c testing, with Same Day reports.
  - Key questions answered: What is an HbA1c test? | When should I get an HbA1c test? | Do I need fasting for HbA1c?
- **Fasting Insulin and HOMA-IR in Bengaluru: A Careful Look** — https://qxldiagnostics.com/blog/fasting-insulin-homa-ir-bengaluru
  - Author/assigned reviewer: Dr. Shantakumar Muruda (medically reviewed)
  - Summary: Fasting insulin and HOMA-IR examine insulin alongside fasting glucose; HOMA-IR is calculated, not a standalone diagnosis. At QXL Diagnostics, insulin uses electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (ECLIA) on Roche cobas pro; glucose is measured on Roche cobas pro.
  - Key questions answered: What are fasting insulin and HOMA-IR? | When should I consider HOMA-IR testing? | Do I need fasting for insulin and HOMA-IR?
- **Thyroid Profile in Bengaluru: Reading TSH, FT3 and FT4** — https://qxldiagnostics.com/blog/thyroid-profile-bengaluru
  - Author/assigned reviewer: Dr. Shantakumar Muruda (medically reviewed)
  - Summary: A thyroid profile measures thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), free triiodothyronine (FT3) and free thyroxine (FT4), often called a thyroid-function check. QXL Diagnostics measures these immunoassay markers by electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (ECLIA) on Roche cobas pro, with Same Day reports.
  - Key questions answered: What does a thyroid profile measure? | When should I get thyroid testing in Bengaluru? | Do I need fasting for a thyroid profile?

#### Preventive Health
- **Vitamin D Testing in Bengaluru: Beyond Everyday Fatigue** — https://qxldiagnostics.com/blog/vitamin-d-bengaluru
  - Author/assigned reviewer: Dr. Shantakumar Muruda (medically reviewed)
  - Summary: The Vitamin D (25-OH) test, also called total 25-hydroxyvitamin D or the sunshine-vitamin test, assesses the main circulating marker of vitamin D status. QXL Diagnostics uses electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (ECLIA) on Roche cobas pro, with Same Day reports.
